# Preserve native label relationships when removing inline presentation

The rename-folder dialog removes the inline label display style but retains its label/input relationship. Accepted source has nameLabel, for=name, aria-labelledby=nameLabel and initial focus/select; acceptance remains disabled for an empty value. Treat this as local presentation cleanup, not proof of every long-label or translated layout. The separate 1853 line wrap is a formatter follow-up and adds no new manual rule. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mailnews/base/content.
